meta.name: Your Honor
meta.description: The story of the forces that inherited wealth centered around the Woowon Group headquarters in the fictional Woowon City adjacent to the sea, the voodoo cartel that dominates the lawless area, and Judge Song Pan-Ho, who comforts citizens seeking justice.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: When his son is involved in a tragic accident, Judge Song Pan-ho is faced with an impossible decision that will impact his family forever.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: On the anniversary of his wife's death,  Pan-ho and Ho-young create an alibi for the day of the accident.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: A favor for Pan-ho pulls his close friend and colleague Jeong Yi-hwa into the web of deception. Sang-hyeok wants to seek revenge. Ho-young spends the day with a dangerous new love interest.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Pan-ho continues to use his power to obscure details of the accident as gang boss Kim Kang-hun searches for his son's murderer. Sang-hyeok makes an attempt to flee the country.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Things aren't adding up for Detective Jang Chae-rim in her investigation. Prosecutor Kang So-Young pays a visit to the Kim's.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Pan-ho, Yi-hwa, and Joo-hee meet to discuss their next move, unaware that they are being followed. Elsewhere, the Seobu Gang attacks the Boodu Gang's territory.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Kim Sang-hyeok's trial begins; Ho-young and Pan-ho have a difficult conversation.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Kang-hun uncovers a shocking truth about the culprit, while Pan-ho is forced to make a difficult decision to save his son.

meta.slogan: How far would you go to save your child?
